blocks.title: Three changes for {{company}}
blocks.text: What we found on your website, your Google profile and how a new patient books today.
Hi {{first_name}}, here’s the note I mentioned. It starts with your site as a new patient sees it:

blocks.title: {{load_time}} seconds to open on a phone

items: {{rating}} stars from {{review_count}} patients. That’s the hardest part to build, and you already have it.
The site is slow on phones
Mostly large photos and a heavy theme. Fix: rebuild the main pages lean, so they open in under two seconds.
The clinics above you post photos often and reply to reviews. Fix: complete the Google profile, add photos monthly, reply to every review.
Booking still starts with a phone call
If nobody picks up, the patient calls the next clinic. Fix: a short booking form that sends each request to your front desk on WhatsApp.
Google profile fixed, and the new home page designed.
The rest of the site built, with the booking form.
Checked on real phones, then live.

blocks.title: Want to see it on your own site?
blocks.text: 15 minutes. I’ll share my screen; nothing to prepare. Between {{price_range}}, depending on pages.
